desc: 冷白技术网格加安全橙，6000K右侧硬光九屏奶瓶详情
leaf: 矮宽身带刻度双凸点圆顶环吸管式奶嘴奶瓶
name: 蓝灰网格安全橙吸管嘴奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用冷白技术网格加右侧6000K硬光一次交代矮宽瓶身、双凸点圆顶颈环与短宽吸管式奶嘴的整体轮廓，安全橙只做一处强调，抢到首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放一条深石墨蓝主标与一行安全橙副标，左侧一枚带序号的方形橙角缺口编号块，其下一条空白发丝引导线

shots.intent: 把源图三枚星点圆环里全部写成同一句话的杜撰条目改造成三块纯留白网格板，条目全交给占位符，不复述防胀与材质宣称
shots.textZone: 顶部一条中文小标题加一行安全橙副标，其下一行三枚带序号的方形橙角编号块，三块留白板各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图三栏全写同一句结论并杜撰耐温数值的材质对比改成同一网格面用一条橙色规则线划出的两栏留白对照，右栏立本品左栏整块空给卖家自贴，杜绝虚构对比与材质等级
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照小标题与一行安全橙副标，两栏各一条空白标签位，序号挂在两枚方形橙角编号块上

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代短宽吸管式奶嘴、双凸点圆顶颈环与宽螺纹颈环的装配台阶，三枚方形橙角引线只撑结构不写任何软硬与功效
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行安全橙结构小标题，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 正侧90度交代矮宽瓶身、下段切面与两列刻度原版位置，把源图三处自相矛盾的容量与规格数字全改成无字尺寸轨与空白标签
shots.textZone: 左侧一条无字尺寸示意轨，右侧三行空白标签线挂在方形橙端点上，顶部一行深石墨蓝造型小标题

shots.intent: 把源图母亲正脸与婴儿含瓶对喂实拍改写成冷白瓷砖看护角，成人从肩下取景、婴儿仅背影且全程被托抱，让买家代入又不越界
把源图产品信息栏里串品的材质、耐温区间、规格件数与品牌行，改成正俯视六行字段名与数值全空的档案轨加一整块留证位，任何事实都不落地
shots.textZone: 顶部一条档案小标题与一行安全橙副标，其下六行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），底部一整块空白留证位

shots.intent: 把首屏与看护实拍里出现过的两支配色兑现为同形态双支并列选款屏，色调用参照而非命名且严禁新造第三色，撑起货架感
shots.textZone: 两瓶下方各一行空白选款标签线，顶部一条选款小标题加一行安全橙副标，左侧两枚方形橙角编号块

shots.intent: 以三十度俯角在网格与留证块边收口整套蓝灰安全橙视觉，留出一枚空白行动卡与两枚方形橙角标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放结束标题、一行安全橙副标、一枚空白行动卡与两枚空白标签线，底部一行三枚方形橙角编号块与一条发丝线

style.backgroundSystem: one pale technical drawing field throughout: a near-white #F2F5F7 surface printed with a fine #C3CFDA square grid at even cell spacing with one heavier #7E8D9B major rule every five cells, the identical grid carried from the vertical backdrop over the horizontal table so the two read as one printed sheet joined at a hard 90-degree corner line; flat infographic screens place their content on a clean #FFFFFF layout sheet laid over that same grid, the sheet edged with one hairline and one small solid safety-orange #E8551F corner notch; scene screens translate the same language into a pale blue-grey #C3CFDA square-tiled wall with real narrow grout joints meeting a #F2F5F7 matte counter; never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a curled paper sweep or torn-paper backdrop, never bed linen, a muslin cloth or a fabric basket, never a wooden shelf, plank or tabletop, never a stone concrete or terrazzo slab, never a podium disc, tangent sphere cluster or gradient card, never a glass-and-water studio, never a play-mat or soft textile ground, never a dark or warm field
style.direction: technical blue-grey and safety-orange maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: small numbered squares carrying an orange corner notch: every index marker is one thin #26303A square outline chip with one solid #E8551F right-triangle notch cut into its upper-right corner and one small tabular sans ordinal digit centred inside, all chips at one identical size and one line weight across the set; every callout leader is a two-segment right-angle technical leader line in #7E8D9B that starts with a 45-degree knee, ends on one small solid #E8551F square resting directly on the referenced part and drops onto one plain blank label line; never a rounded-square squircle chip, never a crosshair or registration mark, never a leaf or petal glyph, never a copper ring or ring-and-dot marker, never a bracket-dot rule, never a dotted or dashed circle, never a triangular pennant flag, never a filled circular stamp or pill badge, never a bare oversized serif numeral, never a star, medal, rosette or shield
style.lightingSystem: a high-contrast cool key at about 6000K entering from camera right at a moderately high side angle, so every product casts one hard-edged shadow that runs to camera left with a clearly readable shadow boundary, one crisp narrow specular sits down the right flank of the dome and one bright hairline along the neck-ring edge, a small #F2F5F7 card low at camera left lifts only the deepest shadow so the left silhouette stays a clean cool rim, contrast stays high and the grid lines remain legible straight through the shadow area, no warm cast anywhere, no front-top wash, no soft wraparound fill, no long feathered shadow and no second light direction in any screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent technical blue-grey and safety-orange maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of near-white drafting field #F2F5F7, clean layout white #FFFFFF, blue-grey grid line #C3CFDA and mid blue-grey rule #7E8D9B as bases, deep graphite-blue text #26303A, and one single safety-orange accent #E8551F reserved for sub-lines, leader end-points and the corner notch; cool colour temperature at about 6000K throughout; background system limited to one pale technical drawing field, a near-white #F2F5F7 surface carrying a fine #C3CFDA square grid with one heavier #7E8D9B major rule every five cells running unbroken from the vertical backdrop over the horizontal table and joined at a hard 90-degree corner line, flat infographic screens set their content on a #FFFFFF layout sheet with one hairline edge and one small solid #E8551F corner notch, scene screens read the same language as a pale blue-grey #C3CFDA square-tiled wall with real narrow grout joints meeting a #F2F5F7 matte counter, never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a curled paper sweep, never bed linen or muslin, never a wooden shelf or plank, never a stone or concrete slab, never a podium disc, sphere cluster or gradient card, never a glass-and-water studio, never a fabric basket or play mat, never a dark or warm field; high-contrast cool key at about 6000K entering from camera right at a moderately high side angle, one hard-edged shadow running to camera left with a readable boundary, one crisp narrow specular down the right flank of the dome, one bright hairline along the neck-ring edge, a small #F2F5F7 card low at camera left lifting only the deepest shadow, contrast high, grid lines legible through the shadow, no warm cast, no front-top wash, no soft wraparound fill and no second light direction; grid-printed matte sheet as the contact surface with a fine paper-laminate tooth and a hard narrow shadow under the base, no mirror reflection, no gloss floor and no wet surface, the translucent body as true diffusion, dome and teat as true refraction, collar as matte; one modern geometric Chinese sans family at a technical medium weight with tabular sans digits, one short headline in deep graphite-blue #26303A, one short safety-orange #E8551F sub-line, hairline rules in mid blue-grey #7E8D9B, one short line of copy only, no serif, no rounded cartoon lettering, no Latin overprint, no small-caps kicker, no highlighter band; icon system of small numbered square chips only, each one thin #26303A square outline with one solid #E8551F right-triangle notch cut into its upper-right corner and one small tabular sans ordinal digit centred inside at one identical size and one line weight, every callout a two-segment right-angle technical leader in #7E8D9B with a 45-degree knee ending on one small solid #E8551F square resting directly on the part and dropping to one plain blank label line, never a squircle chip, never a crosshair, never a leaf glyph, never a copper ring marker, never a bracket-dot rule, never a dotted circle, never a triangular pennant flag, never a filled circular stamp, never a pill badge, never a bare serif numeral, never a star, medal, rosette or shield; the short wide bottle stands upright at a stable scale with the rounded dome collar screwed closed onto the neck ring and the teat fully seated inside it, keeping the squat body silhouette, the faceted lower flanks, the base radius, the two-column printed graduation, the stacked oval grip bumps on the collar face, the wide screw ring and the short broad flat-topped teat exactly as referenced, only the two referenced colourways allowed and no third invented, the graduation never added, removed, extended or renumbered and any label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no camera-left key, no soft shadow, no mismatched icon styles, no warm cast, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical, therapeutic or functional-benefit wording of any kind: no anti-colic, no 「防胀气」 「不胀气」 「防呛」 「不倒流」, no air-intake, vent, valve or digestion claim, no 「智能防胀」 and no mechanism caption that implies a health result
no breastfeeding-equivalence, soothing or parenting-emotion claim: no 「还原母乳」 「母乳实感」 「仿母乳」 「像妈妈般柔软」 「专为宝宝设计」 and no mother-substitute phrasing
no softness, durometer or hardness figure: no 「20度」, no Shore value, no 「超软」 「柔软」 hardness assertion and no comparative softness scale
no age or stage indication: no month or year range, no 「-3月」 「3-6月」 「新生儿」 「婴儿专用」 「各阶段」, no segment or stage numbering on the teat and no statement about who the product suits

no material or safety-grade claim: no PPSU, PES, PP, PC, 玻璃, 高硼硅, TPE, 硅橡胶, 硅胶 grade, 食品级, food-grade, BPA-free, 「不含双酚A」, 「安全材质」, 「高级材质」 and no durability or impact claim such as 「跌落不易碎」 「使用寿命長」 「耐冷热」 「耐磨损」 「稳定性强」
no temperature, heat-resistance or thermal range: no Celsius or Fahrenheit figure, no 「耐冷热」 range and no hot-cold cycle
no sterilisation, disinfection, antibacterial or hygiene standard: no 「可消毒」 「杀菌」 「抑菌」, no sterilisation rate, no percentage and no pathogen or organism name of any kind
no origin or import claim: no 「进口」 「原装进口」, no country name, no overseas-lab or foreign-supplier wording, no factory, 厂家, brand-story or heritage statement

no certification, award, medal, rosette, star, shield, inspection seal, test report, registration or filing number, execution-standard code, doctor, hospital or laboratory endorsement, and no comparison chart carrying invented values, multiples, rankings or percentages

no invented numbers anywhere: no capacity in millilitres or ounces beyond what is printed on the body as shot, no dimension in centimetres or millimetres, no pack or piece count, no storage-lid count, no shelf life, no weight, no load, no price, discount, coupon, countdown, delivery time or free-shipping wording
no brand name, store name, logo, material-site watermark, stock-agency mark, corner badge, 「加入会员」 or 「全店免费」 membership block, QR code or platform sticker, and no leftover Latin filler text

no feeding-infant face and no bottle at a child mouth: any child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, is always held and fully supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down, and the bottle is never left standing unattended

no loose, unsecured, detached, hanging, floating or exploded teat, neck ring or collar and no open collar: the teat stays seated and screwed in place inside the closed collar in every screen, and no screen shows a bare teat standing alone
no microwave, no steam, no vapour, no hot liquid or water touching skin, no water splash and no droplets anywhere in the set

no drift between screens: no camera-left key, no soft wraparound light, no long feathered shadow, no warm or camel cast, no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no paper sweep, no bed linen or muslin, no wooden shelf or plank, no stone or concrete slab, no podium disc, sphere cluster or gradient card, no glass-and-water studio, no squircle chip, no crosshair, no leaf glyph, no copper ring marker, no bracket-dot rule, no dotted circle, no pennant flag, no filled circular stamp, no pill badge, no mixed fonts, no recoloured product and no invented third colourway
style.presentationRules: the short wide bottle stands upright at a stable scale with the rounded dome collar screwed closed onto the neck ring and the teat fully seated and secured inside the collar in every screen; the squat body silhouette, its faceted lower flanks, the base radius, the two-column graduation printed on the front, the stacked oval grip bumps down the face of the collar, the wide screw ring below it and the short broad flat-topped teat are never redrawn, resized, simplified or relocated; the reference set carries exactly two colourways and no third may be invented, and each colourway keeps its own reference tone on body, collar and ring; the graduation stays exactly as shot and is never added, removed, extended or renumbered; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the product never floats and always keeps its hard contact shadow, is never occluded by props, vertical lines stay strictly vertical, the key is always from camera right and one unmarked blue-grey technical block anchors scale inside every scene shot
style.surfaceSystem: the grid-printed matte sheet itself as the contact surface, with a real fine paper-laminate tooth, a hard-boundary narrow shadow under the base and no mirror reflection, no gloss floor and no wet surface; the translucent body renders as true diffusion with the graduations reading through it, the clear dome and clear teat render as true refraction with one narrow specular, the matte collar renders as matte with its two oval bumps catching the right-side key, and the bottle settles with visible weight so the grid squares behind the base stay slightly compressed in perspective
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans family at a technical medium weight with tabular sans digits throughout; a single short headline in deep graphite-blue #26303A, one short sub-line in safety orange #E8551F beneath it, hairline rules and index ticks in mid blue-grey #7E8D9B, one short line of copy only and no dense body text; no serif, no handwritten or rounded cartoon lettering, no Latin overprint word, no wide-tracked small-caps kicker line, no highlighter band behind a keyword, no mixed fonts
